title: Take-Two Boss Predicts Cloud Streaming in 'Three Years', Raising GTA 6 Questions
description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick predicts the industry will embrace game streaming in about three years, raising post-release questions for GTA 6 amid an all-digital shift.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two CEO Predicts Game Streaming is Just 'Three Years' Away

In Take-Two's latest financial report, CEO Strauss Zelnick has made some bold statements regarding the ultimate future trajectory of the video game industry. As the broader market continues to reel from major industry shifts—such as Sony's controversial decision to halt the manufacturing of physical disc-based games and pivot toward an 'all-digital future'—Zelnick believes that digital ownership is only the stepping stone. According to his outlook, we won't just embrace digital games moving forward; we will be streaming our games as well.

Zelnick's comments highlight a rapidly evolving landscape where traditional distribution models are being aggressively re-evaluated by industry leaders. While the immediate industry focus remains locked on the transition away from physical media, Take-Two's leadership is already looking several steps ahead toward cloud-based execution.

## Raising Post-Release Questions for GTA 6

These forward-looking statements from the top executive naturally raise significant questions regarding the long-term post-release strategy for upcoming blockbusters, most notably *GTA 6*. With Take-Two anticipating a massive shift toward streaming within roughly a three-year window, analysts and players are left wondering how massive, graphically intensive open-world titles will adapt to a streaming-dominant ecosystem.

While the source material points directly to Zelnick's financial report disclosures, the intersection of an all-digital transition and the eventual rollout of cloud streaming introduces complex considerations for player access, server infrastructure, and game preservation. As the industry navigates this turbulent era of transition, the choices made by publishers like Take-Two will undoubtedly define the next generation of interactive entertainment.

## Editor's Take

Strauss Zelnick's vision of a streaming-dominated gaming landscape in just three years is fiercely ambitious. As the industry marches away from physical discs, how monumental releases like GTA 6 will adapt to this streaming-first future remains one of the most compelling questions for the years ahead.
